reviewer: Codex via opened official web pages

units.name: 工业工程系 (Department of Industrial Engineering)
units.evidence: Official current College of Management and Economics department page explicitly names 工业工程系; current department professor page lists a doctoral supervisor taking Management Science and Engineering doctoral applicants.

units.name: 运营与供应链管理系 (Department of Operations and Supply Chain Management)
units.evidence: Official current college department page explicitly names 运营与供应链管理系 and describes its Management Science and Engineering doctoral pathway in logistics/supply chain, with Management Science and Engineering or Industrial Engineering award wording.

units.name: 信息管理与管理科学系 (Department of Information Management and Management Science)
units.evidence: Official current college department page names 信息管理与管理科学系. The English rendering is literal; Management Science is in the unit title. The field enum uses operations-research as the closest quantitative classification, not as an assertion that the unit's official name says Operations Research.

sources.note: Full official English university 2026 graduate admissions page, current institutional name and doctoral provision.
Full official Industrial Engineering department page.
Full official Operations and Supply Chain Management department page and doctoral pathway description.
Full official Information Management and Management Science department page.
Full current official IE department professor profile; PhD admissions field Management Science and Engineering.

limitations: Management Science and Engineering is the independently confirmed current PhD discipline; the three department labels are distinct organizational units, not three separately awarded doctoral degrees.
The Operations department page mentions an Industrial Engineering award alternative, but an independent current admissions route/award is not confirmed and is not separately counted.
